proof_body:
by
  intro p q
  refine ⟨{ carrier := {y | ∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, HasDerivAt y (v t) t ∧
              HasDerivAt v (-(p t * v t) - q t * y t) t}
            add_mem' := ?_
            zero_mem' := ?_
            smul_mem' := ?_ }, fun y => Iff.rfl⟩
  · rintro y₁ y₂ ⟨v₁, h₁⟩ ⟨v₂, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨fun t => v₁ t + v₂ t, fun t => ⟨(h₁ t).1.add (h₂ t).1, ?_⟩⟩
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s => v₁ s + v₂ s)
        ((-(p t * v₁ t) - q t * y₁ t) + (-(p t * v₂ t) - q t * y₂ t)) t :=
      (h₁ t).2.add (h₂ t).2
    refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  · refine ⟨fun _ => 0, fun t => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact hasDerivAt_const t (0 : ℝ)
    · have h := hasDerivAt_const t (0 : ℝ)
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      simp
  · rintro c y ⟨v, h⟩
    refine ⟨fun t => c * v t, fun t => ⟨(h t).1.const_mul c, ?_⟩⟩
    refine ((h t).2.const_mul c).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (p q : ℝ → ℝ), ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (ℝ → ℝ), ∀ y : ℝ → ℝ, y ∈ S ↔ ∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, HasDerivAt y (v t) t ∧ HasDerivAt v (-(p t * v t) - q t * y t) t
